description: Data from: Hydropower reservoirs will lead energy-sector carbon emissions by 2050 under a net-zero scenario is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Zilin Wang, Meili Feng. This repository contains the supplementary datasets accompanying the manuscript entitled "Hydropower reservoirs will lead energy-sector carbon emissions by 2050 under a Net-Zero Scenario." Measurement_datasetThis dataset contains the global reservoir greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions database used in this study. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 124312006 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
